messages:
morgan: quick sync — sharing a lightweight proposal for regrouping the left sidebar and how deep links / breadcrumbs should map to URL. sketch: https://figma.com/file/abcd (attached)
jia: looked — overall 👍 I like grouping by user intent (Authoring, Serving, Observability) instead of product nouns. avoids 'Models' vs 'Workflows' confusion.
claire: small concern: if we collapse some items into 'Authoring' will power users lose quick access to model registry actions?
sam: agree w/ claire, but we can keep a quick-actions toolbar (pin favorite pages) so advanced flows stay 1-2 clicks.
morgan: idea: 3 primary zones + pinned shortcuts. zones = Authoring | Deployments | Insights. Under Authoring: Model registry, Prompt library, Eval suites.
loren: for breadcrumbs: prefer path-based breadcrumbs that match URL segments, not UI-only labels. That keeps deep links stable for external tooling. Example: `/app/:org/:workspace/authoring/models/:modelId/versions/:versionId`
jia: that URL shape looks good. question: should the third segment be pluralized (models) or abstract (assets)? plural helps readability and breadcrumbs.
claire: accessibility nit — when collapsing groups we need clear aria-expanded state and an alt-label for the pin button. Also keyboard focus order must never skip pinned shortcuts.
morgan: noted. i'll add a11y checklist: keyboard nav, aria roles, skip-links, focus trap tests.
sam: routing fallback: if a resource is removed (e.g., model deleted) we should fallback to the nearest list page and show a toast with 'resource not found — here are similar items' to avoid a 404 shell.
loren: +1. also suggest a lightweight resolver on the client that tries to map legacy routes (old /models/123 -> /authoring/models/123). decouple router config from UI labels.
dev-bot: deploy-notice: staging nav-refactor branch CI passed (build #1327).
morgan: tolerate breaking: we should support backwards compatibility for external bookmarks for 3 months before hard-removing legacy aliases.
jia: question on breadcrumbs: do we show the workspace name in the crumb trail or keep topbar only? showing workspace in crumbs is redundant for small screens. maybe hide it on <760px.
claire: agree hide on small screens. but expose a compact crumb like 'w: acme-co' when collapsed so screen reader users still learn context.
sam: copy tweaks: instead of 'Deployments' maybe 'Serving' — less ops-y for product folks. thoughts?
morgan: good point. can we run a quick in-channel poll? thumbs up for 'Serving', thumbs down for 'Deployments'.
jia: :thumbsup: Serving feels more product-focused.
loren: :thumbsdown: Deployments is more precise for SREs.
claire: :thumbsup: Serving is friendly.
morgan: fwiw, we can use 'Serving (Deployments)' in hover title for clarity.
dev-bot: reminder: UX review meeting Friday 11am — include mockups and URL spec.
morgan: action items: 1) jia to add URL schema doc + legacy aliases (due Thu) 2) claire to draft a11y checklist + keyboard flows (due Wed) 3) sam to prototype pinned shortcut UX (due Fri) 4) loren to draft router fallback/resolver implementation notes (due Thu). tagging owners on the doc.
jia: I'll create the PR for path mapping and include unit tests for resolver.
claire: i'll stub keyboard testcases in axe report.
sam: prototyping using small toolbar — will post interactive gif.
morgan: thanks all. if no major blockers i'll push the proposal for design review on Friday. @here
